matched.note: Same defect: GitChangedFiles splits git diff/ls-files output with strings.Fields, breaking on space-containing filenames.
Same defect: removal of the four Edit/Write ask-gate entries for **/*.acdsl and acdsl/** from settings.json, leaving repos on the hook default free mode unprotected.

uncataloged.reason: Verified against internal/acdsl/policy.go:322-329: on baseErr!=nil, CheckPolicy branches solely on the local, unverified policy.Mode (LoadPolicy defaults an absent/deleted acdsl/policy.json to Mode=free) before basePolicy() ever gets a chance to substitute the authoritative base-ref value — contradicting the function's own doc comment ("a branch cannot weaken the mode by editing or deleting the working policy.json"). This is a distinct silent-bypass mechanism (deleted working file + unresolvable base) from the free-mode short-circuits already catalogued as GV3-001/GV3-002/GV4-202, and is a materially stronger correctness/security claim than GV3-108's generic INFO-level "branch is untested" note (which does not identify the mode-trust design flaw). Not catalogued in golden as a standalone finding.

Verified: the plan (plans/v1-2-1/2026-08-26-railroad-review-observability-wip-5158764/design/raw.md, D1 and Changelog) commits to fixing lane-context injection by applying the hook's existing --no-context opt-out token in railroad-review.js. The shipped code (skills/quality/railroad-review/workflows/railroad-review.js:202, introduced by commit c1b52fb together with the new cmd/hooks/skill-invoke-gate.sh) instead invokes the skill bare/no-args and relies on skill-invoke-gate.sh to force full doctrine injection on every lane -- the opposite mechanism from D1 -- and the plan's Changelog (last entry 2026-08-26) was never updated to record this pivot. Distinct plan-vs-code contradiction from GV3-153 (which is about read-gate.sh's required_files() subagent-spill change contradicting a different plan line, line 38's read-gate.sh "stays as-is" note). Not catalogued in golden as a standalone finding.

Verified against internal/acdsl/policy.go:82-90: classViolations rebuilds a fresh editable map from policy.EditableScopes on every call, and CheckPolicy calls it three times per invocation (lines 372-374) for delta.added/changed/removed. Genuine, minor, in-range inefficiency; not catalogued in golden.

Verified against routines/smine-nightly/run.sh:29-45: the presentation-profile block reads three fields (language, audience, dev-mode) via three separate sed -n calls, and the resulting dev_mode/orchestrate/auto_apply variables are derived through env>profile>default precedence conditionals with no explanatory comment. Genuine, minor, in-range readability nit; not catalogued in golden (the run.sh golden entries GV3-009/046/098/099/114/130/196/GV4-205/GV6-251 address different defects — untested branches, gating bugs, and a stale rename comment, not this precedence-derivation clarity point).
